about.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
about.head: 21ba1c3

name: v1.4.226
body:
## UI / workspace
* fix(sidebar): stop the workspace link icon lighting up on hover by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28078
* Share any HTML file from the editor and the remote preview by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27608
* Use a minimize icon in the Update skills dialog by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28107
* fix(diff): stop closed diff editors from leaking through Monaco's gutter menu by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27793
* refactor(automations): main creates an automation workspace's setup and default tabs by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28130
* feat(crash-reporting): name the code behind a renderer out-of-memory crash by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27814
* fix(i18n): correct Korean Settings translations by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28183
* fix(i18n): translate Settings help as whole sentences instead of fragments by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28185
* fix(editor): keep a pinned duplicate open on close and ignore setActiveFile for a missing file by @BearMett in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28120
* fix(floating-workspace): open the floating panel instead of blanking the main window on host reveals by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28184
* Close worktree ready notification when its workspace opens by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28238
* refactor(runtime): main alone starts setup and default tabs for an activated create by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28153
* Show folder workspaces in the Cmd+J jump palette by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28175
* refactor(main): share one caller-signal + timeout helper by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28393
* fix(notifications): remove read macOS notifications from Notification Center by pane thread by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28425
* fix(automations): format the jobs-file limit consistently by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28220
* fix: update status bar and tray labels when language changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28226
* Preserve significant spaces in Explorer contents search by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28222
* fix(process-host): accept string stdin in synchronous runs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28225
* Fix Vercel recipe failures on stock macOS Bash by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28257
* fix(cli): warn when a workspace status has no board column by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28264
* fix(speech): release dictation window listeners after stop by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28260
* fix: nest settings translation keys for language packs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28251
* fix(files): never write through a dangling symlink by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28385
* feat(new-workspace): add "None" agent option that opens only the setup script by @leog in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25617
* chore(i18n): translate 259 new keys to es/fr/ja/ko/zh by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28486
* fix(i18n): correct literal-sense Japanese mistranslations by @sojiro-o in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28535
* Clear agent selections in workspace creation and settings by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28543
* feat(cli): open files at a requested line and column by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28240
* fix(jira): keep issue titles readable in narrow panels by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28583
* fix(jira): keep description and comment hyperlinks clickable by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28584
* feat(cli): let agents read and update Jira tickets safely by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28592
* fix(jira): support scoped Cloud API tokens by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28604
* fix(jira): keep edits and comments visible while saving by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28585
* Search connected tasks by keyword from Cmd+J by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28617
* feat(jira): generate issue titles on the connection host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28625
* Fix Jira Cloud All and classify presets by ticket status by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28579
* feat(cli): resolve Jira keys in workspace references by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28619
* Show every linked Jira workspace and add a Has Workspace view by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28590
* fix(integrations): notice Jira and Linear state changes from other processes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28594
* feat(jira): add row quick copy and reusable prompt templates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28618
* Save and reuse named Jira JQL filters on the execution host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28600
* feat(jira): choose planning columns in the issue list by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28615
* Filter Jira preset views by multiple workflow statuses by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28623
* Choose Jira key casing and keep canonical Jira keys in review titles by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28596
* fix(jira): collect required fields before changing status by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28588
* Make existing Jira assignees searchable and add Assign to me by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28612
* View Jira work on a board and filter the current sprint by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28633
* feat(jira): load attachment images outside issue Markdown by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28631
* feat(jira): remember repository project defaults by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28622
* refactor(unread): one workspace-attention module owns every unread transition by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28538
* Split Jira issue workspace hooks and IPC param checks by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28759
* fix(unread): a pane is read when it is on screen; closing a waiting tab clears its dot by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28637

## Orchestration
* fix(chat): name orchestration worker chat tabs after their task title by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28045
* fix(orchestration): stop retried failed worker starts from piling up live agents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27795
* Shorten worker sub-dispatch instructions by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28565

## Agents / native chat
* Show turn edit diffs inline in native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27758
* Terminal header button: Resume in New Native Chat replaces Show chat view by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27184
* fix(native-chat): message rail lights a message sent while the agent was working by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27821
* Keep a "chats resumed" entry in the bottom bar until you've seen the result by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27580
* feat(native-chat): wrap long lines in code blocks by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26130
* fix(rate-limits): start the Codex usage probe off the main thread so focus doesn't freeze the UI by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27707
* Native chat: read one saved row per subagent (part 1 of 2) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27914
* fix(chat): name the agent when it refuses a message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27946
* feat(native-chat): require Codex 0.136.0 for chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26684
* feat(settings): move Chat UI's chat settings from Experimental to the Chat page by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28050
* refactor(chat): give the start-refusal resumable table its own module by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28085
* Session History shows OpenCode, Grok, OMP and Pi chats as chats and refuses a second terminal writer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27183
* feat(native-chat): each Claude/Codex chat gets its own permission mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26116
* Replace chat upgrade switch with primary Enable Now button by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28113
* fix(i18n): drop chat-mode keys removed from en.json in #28113 by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28131
* fix(tab-bar): native chat tabs show their recorded provider, not one guessed from the title by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28082
* feat(chat): host writes one saved row per subagent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27947
* Resume toast: say what happened and name its action by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28068
* Make Enable Now the full-width action in the chat upgrade tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28199
* fix(native-chat): seed the chat permission default from Claude's and Codex's own arguments by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28100
* chore(session): delete three session paths nothing calls any more by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28152
* feat(settings): move Permissions for new chats into the Chat page's Behavior section by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28212
* After a restart, an agent tab asks the terminal host what is running, never "Couldn't confirm the agent started" by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28043
* Fix delayed agent launches such as sleep 30 && claude by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28205
* Show Codex model capacity failures as red agent status by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28231
* feat(native-chat): expand mermaid diagrams into a pan and zoom viewer by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27715
* fix(automations): stop offering Resume workspace for runs that never started an agent (STA-10103) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28179
* fix(native-chat): chats from before permission modes keep the mode they were running with by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28099
* fix(usage): cap Cursor's Retry-After at 24h and share one Retry-After parser by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28406
* Resume in New Native Chat for Grok and OMP terminal conversations by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28049
* Host plans agent launches with the window's runtime rule and one runtime fact (C1) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27692
* fix(native-chat): Stop is saved before it acts, and a late or repeated Stop does nothing by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27076
* fix(usage): show "Network issue" for any provider whose usage request fails on the network by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28415
* feat(native-chat): show context usage in Codex chats by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28084
* refactor(session-history): one decision for a row's open and resume offers by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28360
* fix(usage): usage requests answer authenticated-proxy challenges on a cold start by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28411
* fix(agent-status): preserve open chat status when terminals close by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28188
* fix(native-chat): slash-menu command names no longer look oversized by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28461
* fix(packaging): copy the Codex TOML parser into packaged Orca by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28416
* feat(native-chat): combine model and options into one picker by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27972
* fix(agent-status): retire any restored agent row whose terminal died while Orca was closed (STA-10194) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28475
* fix: a Claude model that's gone switches to the list's default when you send by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27826
* AI buttons stop writing a launch record by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28209
* fix(native-chat): store a chat's permission mode on its own, so a model pick can't reset it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28268
* refactor(native-chat): rename the chat visuals folder to the chat scratch folder by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28389
* fix(native-chat): pass the clock to a recorded option pick by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28571
* AI-button and OpenCode-model tabs start their agent in their own terminal by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28210
* fix(session-history): refuse desktop resumes of chat-owned conversations by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28229
* fix(native-chat): drop the duplicate now key left by crossing fixes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28599
* feat(acp): questions an agent sends as permission requests are never auto-answered by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28449
* Resume in New Native Chat for OpenCode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28072
* Native chat: a message stopped before the agent got it reaches the agent with your next send by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27623
* feat(runtime-files): the host serves a chat's scratch folder as a file root by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28397

## Windows / WSL
* fix(browser): settle WSL tunnel reads so responses past 256 KiB complete by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27625
* fix(kimi): give Kimi a Windows .cmd status hook that cmd.exe can run by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27714
* fix(agent-hooks): register forward-slash Windows hook paths for Grok, Devin, ZCode and Antigravity by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27713
* fix(daemon): verify daemon PID identity from the native Windows process table, not PowerShell by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27703
* fix(claude): register the Windows statusLine so usage updates without Git Bash by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27710
* fix(wsl): start every host wsl.exe call through process-host so no console window flashes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27628
* fix(wsl): run WSL git with Windows Git line-ending settings on checkouts Windows Git wrote by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27778
* fix(wsl): recheck watcher-reported paths with full stat on Windows Git drive checkouts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27817
* fix(daemon): keep the relocated Windows daemon host's conpty.dll under the path limit by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28156
* feat(wsl): orcad host transport over wsl.exe (WSL-via-orcad C1) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27792
* feat(wsl): detached distro holder re-adopted from a pid file (WSL-via-orcad C3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27800
* feat(wsl): deploy and launch orcad inside a WSL distro (WSL-via-orcad C4) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27819
* fix(windows): restrict secure files in-process instead of spawning icacls by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28135
* feat(wsl): connect to a WSL distro's orcad over wsl.exe stdio only (WSL-via-orcad C5) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27834
* feat(wsl): liveness, failure classification and recovery for WSL orcad (WSL-via-orcad C6) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27916
* feat(wsl): accounts shim for agents on a WSL orcad host (WSL-via-orcad C9) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27874
* feat(wsl): account env for agent tabs on a WSL orcad host (WSL-via-orcad C9b) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27940
* feat(wsl): WSL distro hosts, main-process wiring and persistence (WSL-via-orcad C7a, experimental) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27933
* refactor(orcad-migration): migration source abstraction, capability-gated source.kind, path-rewrite stage (WSL-via-orcad D0) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27790
* feat(wsl): Add WSL distro host UI and status (WSL-via-orcad C7b, experimental) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27934
* feat(wsl): Windows path actions for WSL hosts through one owner-routed capability (WSL-via-orcad C8) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27955
* refactor(wsl): register WSL host IPC only when the WSL host service exists by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28446
* fix(wsl-host): orcad's own git sees the login shell's SSH agent, proxy and signing env by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28456
* refactor(wsl): checked command-channel construction and the shared keyed queue by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28448
* fix(orcad): keep Codex status hooks in a managed account home on a WSL host, and list its sessions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28469
* Support restarting Windows Orca as administrator by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28073
* feat(wsl-mover): decide every piece of project state and add a losslessness check (D1b-1) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28459
* feat(wsl-mover): accept local WSL projects on the migration wire, only in their own distro (D1b-2) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28466
* refactor(wsl): reuse the WSL-host predicate, error helper and a shared owner lookup by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28447
* fix(accounts): a focused WSL host shows and switches its distro's accounts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28465
* fix(accounts): launches a WSL host starts itself use the account selected for its distro by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28464
* fix(wsl-host): let an app update reach a WSL host orcad (E1) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28458
* feat(wsl-mover): choose which projects a distro move takes and rewrite their paths (D1b-3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28473
* fix(agent-launch): refuse an agent whose WSL runtime needs repair under its own code, in the settings page's words by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28232
* feat(wsl-mover): bind the host to its distro registration and preflight every moved path (D1b-4) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28542
* fix(agent-detection): trust a WSL share path's distro in the agent list, over Orca's cached distro list by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28233
* feat(wsl-mover): a journal and fence for local WSL moves, on one shared journal store (D1b-5a) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28536
* feat(wsl-mover): terminal gate, last-folder capture and exit proof for a WSL move (D1b-5b) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28606
* feat(wsl-mover): fence moving projects from new terminals and hide them once the host owns them (D1b-5c) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28668

## Terminal
* chore: upgrade terminal dependencies to matching payload betas by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27935
* fix(layout): save terminal rows in the tab groups' order by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28066
* fix(terminal): keep the tab when a reattach finds its process gone by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28067
* fix(terminal): show a host-created setup split in the window that holds its tab by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28105
* feat(daemon): pace automatic terminal restores on the desktop too by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28202
* fix(terminal): name a new tab's first pane so its saved layout is never empty by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28168
* feat(linux): run the AppImage terminal daemon off the mount, on the extracted copy's bundled Node by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28214
* fix(terminal-daemon): status says live, exited or unverifiable, and shows the process ceiling by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28239
* fix(daemon): a stop requested from outside never counts as a crash by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28307
* fix(linux): unpack the AppImage copy in the background so the first daemon runs from it by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28311
* fix(layout): restore the saved active group as a window does in the session-tabs projection by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28174
* fix(terminal): a slow window no longer makes `orca terminal create` fail and then duplicate by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28158
* Start a startup terminal while Orca's window is hidden instead of waiting for it to be shown by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28351
* fix(terminal): send only the text a Linux IME commits, not the candidate key by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28275
* fix(terminal): retain CRLF split across output chunks by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28224
* Preserve valid terminal file links when another candidate fails by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28272
* fix(terminal): keep the text of an IME key pressed before a commit finalizes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28441
* fix(keybindings): match modifier chords pressed during IME composition by physical key by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28620
* fix(terminal): don't report kitty releases for key presses the app never received by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28621
* fix(terminal): store the Terminal shell setting trimmed so agent tabs start like plain tabs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28635
* refactor(pty): one failure cleanup and agent_error for both terminal spawn paths by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28613
* fix(terminal): judge an agent's --shell against the runtime it runs in by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28234

## Remote server / SSH
* fix(orcad): identify instances by kernel start ticks, not drifting wall-clock start time by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28125
* fix(runtime): stop a project's terminals before the host forgets the project by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28024
* fix(terminal): keep a named terminal's title across an orca serve restart by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28126
* fix(ssh): let existing profiles migrate without losing client history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28141
* build(linux): carry the pinned Node inside the AppImage so serve's slot works offline by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28204
* fix(serve): clearer headless-display and supervisor messages on Linux by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28230
* fix(linux): direct AppImage serve honours the chosen profile and --supervise by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28227
* fix(linux): register the stable launcher when serving from an extracted AppImage by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28241
* fix(ssh): show managed hosts once in the connection menu by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28277
